newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to provide finance for 250,000 ha cotton.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to provide finance for 250,000 ha cotton.

text.p: The Paraguayan government said Tuesday that it will provide cheap financing sufficient for its farmers to sow 250,000 hectares with 1997/98 cotton.
"The money which we have available will be enough for 250,000 hectares to be sown," Agriculture Minister Cayo Franco told reporters.
He said the government will offer farmers credit lines at interest rates under 20 percent.
Paraguayan farmers produced 135,000 tonnes of raw cotton in 1996/97 from a sown area of 150,000 hectares. Production was way down from the previous season's 330,000 tonnes.
